_what: Sounds in the Faery Yurt. A tile in Helen's Regulation Nook that has one is a button; pressing it plays it. Easter eggs Ryan and Helen wanted in her room.
_consent: A voice identifies a person as surely as a face does, so this follows the polaroid wall's process and the yell button's — who it is, named how they want to be named, and the date they agreed. Withdrawal is deletion: remove the entry, remove the file, remove that tile's markers from faery-yurt.html, and run the tool. The tile goes back to being a tile.
_licence: These two are Ryan's, recorded by Ryan, so they are CC BY-SA 4.0 like the rest of the site. A recording by anybody else would carry NO onward licence — see LICENSE — because CC BY-SA cannot be revoked and a person who lends us their voice has to be able to take it back. The tool does not decide which; it records who, and LICENSE says what follows.
_runtime: Not written here. tools/make-yurt-sound.py measures it out of each file, the same way make-og.py measures whether a card fits rather than trusting a number somebody typed. Every press-to-play control on this site says how long before the press — the jukebox, The Chappell, the audio room's sequence — and a hand-kept duration is a label that goes quietly wrong.
_markers: Each sound needs its own <!-- yurt-sound:<id>:begin --> / :end pair around its tile in faery-yurt.html. Markers rather than a generated list, so the five silent tiles stay Helen's hand-written markup and the tool only touches the ones it owns. A sound with no markers is a refusal, and so is a marker pair with no sound.
